setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A trained pack animal refuses to pull a heavy cart.

choices.label: Lighten the load and ask again.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A sore hoof is discovered, and the animal later recovers.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: No injury is found, and the cart remains unmoved.

text_only.reason: nobody is hurt: the animal is examined

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The animal moves comfortably with less weight.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The animal still refuses, and the villagers stop.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The villagers finish the journey together.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The work strains several tired laborers.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The cart crosses the hill without the animal.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The charm wavers, and the group must secure the load.
